# AP Remodeling Handyman List

> AP Remodeling Handyman List is a small, owner-run handyman and home remodeling company in Elkhart, Indiana. Owner Charles Poe has 30+ years in business. The company handles everyday repairs, bathroom and kitchen remodeling, flooring, and siding and window replacement for homeowners in Northern Indiana and Southwest Michigan. Estimates are free.

## Business Information

- Name: AP Remodeling Handyman List

## Services

- [Flooring Installation](https://ap-remodeling-handyman-list.pageone.cloud/services/flooring-installation/): flooring for baths, bedrooms and living areas, including tile.
- [Siding & Window Replacement](https://ap-remodeling-handyman-list.pageone.cloud/services/siding-window-replacement/): siding and window replacement with trim, caulking and drywall returns finished.
- [Bathroom & Kitchen Remodeling](https://ap-remodeling-handyman-list.pageone.cloud/services/remodeling-services/): bathroom and kitchen remodels, with tile, drywall, paint and fixtures handled by one company.
- [Handyman Services](https://ap-remodeling-handyman-list.pageone.cloud/services/additional-services/): drywall repair, interior and exterior painting, door installation and repair, TV mounting, shelving installation, furniture assembly, fixture replacement, caulking and weatherproofing, deck repair, fence repair, and small home repairs.
- [All services](https://ap-remodeling-handyman-list.pageone.cloud/services/)

## About

AP Remodeling Handyman List is a small company in Elkhart, Indiana, owned by Charles Poe, with 30+ years in business. It takes on everyday handyman repairs and larger remodeling jobs, so a homeowner can call one number for a sticking door or a full bathroom. The company works with its own job photos on the site, and says plainly when a job is out of range.

## Key Differentiators

- One company handles both small repairs and larger remodeling jobs, so tile, drywall patching and paint on a bathroom remodel are done by the same crew.
- Owner-run small company with 30+ years in business.
- Open seven days a week, 9 AM to 6 PM.
- Free estimates; the job is priced after the estimate visit.
- Honors the manufacturer warranties on the products it installs.
